lines.zh: 我小步小步地走，怕踩到自己的影子。
lines.en: I take tiny steps, afraid of stepping on my shadow.

lines.zh: 我沿着石像的裂缝走，那里最凉。
lines.en: I walk along the statue's cracks, where it is coolest.

lines.zh: 四条短腿倒得很快，声音很小。
lines.en: Four short legs move fast and make almost no sound.

lines.zh: 我从壳状的石头里钻出来，抖了抖土。
lines.en: I crawl from the shell-shaped stone and shake off dirt.

lines.zh: 走过苔藓时，我会停下来闻一闻。
lines.en: Crossing moss, I stop to sniff it.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，风就吹不到我。
lines.en: I hug the ground so the wind cannot reach me.

lines.zh: 我的爪子太软，走碎石路会打滑。
lines.en: My claws are soft and slip on gravel.

lines.zh: 我绕着那尊航蠕螺雕像走了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the nauticrawl statue once.

lines.zh: 走两步，回头看一眼，再走两步。
lines.en: Two steps, a look back, then two more.

lines.zh: 我喜欢走在你脚边，那里有影子。
lines.en: I like walking by your feet, where the shade is.

lines.zh: 石像的螺旋口是我的门，我进进出出。
lines.en: The statue's spiral mouth is my door.

lines.zh: 我跳上小石头，再跳下来，练习。
lines.en: I hop onto a pebble and down again, practicing.

lines.zh: 走路时尾巴会翘起来，我控制不住。
lines.en: My tail lifts as I walk, and I cannot help it.

lines.zh: 我踩着落叶走，声音像我心跳。
lines.en: I walk on fallen leaves, and the sound is my heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我迈一小步，先试试石头稳不稳。
lines.en: I take a small step, testing whether the stone holds.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的鞋走，踩过的地方安全。
lines.en: I follow your shoes. Where they step is safe.

lines.zh: 我缩在雕像的螺旋里，只露出鼻子。
lines.en: I curl in the statue's spiral with only my nose out.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，装成一块小石头。
lines.en: I hold perfectly still and pretend to be a pebble.

lines.zh: 尘土落在我背上，我不去拍。
lines.en: Dust settles on my back and I do not brush it off.

lines.zh: 我在数石壁上的纹路，一共七道。
lines.en: I count the lines on the stone wall: seven.

lines.zh: 肚子饿了，我就啃一口身边的草。
lines.en: When hungry, I nibble the grass beside me.

lines.zh: 我打了个小喷嚏，把自己吓了一跳。
lines.en: I sneeze a little and startle myself.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我能听见雕像里的回声。
lines.en: In the quiet I hear an echo inside the statue.

lines.zh: 我把脸埋进前爪，这样比较暖。
lines.en: I bury my face in my forepaws, which is warmer.

lines.zh: 我在等有人经过，又怕真的有人来。
lines.en: I wait for someone to pass, yet fear it too.

lines.zh: 太阳挪一格，我就跟着挪一格。
lines.en: The sun shifts a notch and I shift with it.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔爪子，土味有点咸。
lines.en: I lick my paws; the dirt tastes faintly of salt.

lines.zh: 这块石头是暖的，我趴上面不动。
lines.en: This stone is warm, and I lie on it without moving.

lines.zh: 我听见远处的水声，想起海。
lines.en: I hear water far off and remember the sea.

lines.zh: 我把自己卷成一个球，只留耳朵。
lines.en: I roll into a ball with only my ears showing.

lines.zh: 我用爪子理了理耳朵边的毛。
lines.en: I comb the fur by my ear with a paw.

lines.zh: 外面有风，我把头往里缩了缩。
lines.en: Wind outside. I pull my head in a little.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼睛比你指甲还小。
lines.en: I look up at you with eyes smaller than your nail.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来的样子，让我放松了一点。
lines.en: The way you crouch puts me a little at ease.

lines.zh: 你的手很大，我不太敢靠近。
lines.en: Your hands are huge, and I keep my distance.

lines.zh: 我一直看着你的口袋，那里有味道。
lines.en: I keep watching your pocket; something smells there.

lines.zh: 你眨眼，我也眨眼，慢一点点。
lines.en: You blink, and I blink a moment after.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我，我就不那么怕了。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me and I am less afraid.

lines.zh: 我从雕像后面探头，只露半张脸。
lines.en: I peek from behind the statue, half a face only.

lines.zh: 你说话的声音很低，我喜欢。
lines.en: Your voice is low, and I like it.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁和草的味道，很复杂。
lines.en: You smell of iron and grass, which is complicated.

lines.zh: 我歪着头看你，想弄明白你是什么。
lines.en: I tip my head, puzzling over what manner of beast you are.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我先退半步，又停下。
lines.en: You reach out; I step back half a pace, then stop.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，我的耳朵在动。
lines.en: While you look at me, my ears keep moving.

lines.zh: 我尖叫了一声，声音比身子大。
lines.en: I shriek, and the sound is far bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打翻，我爬起来又倒。
lines.en: The blow flips me; I get up and fall again.

lines.zh: 我的腿在抖，停不下来。
lines.en: My legs are shaking and will not stop.

lines.zh: 别打了，我可以躲进石头里。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; I can hide inside the stone.

lines.zh: 我流了一点血，很少，但很疼。
lines.en: I bleed a little, very little, but it hurts.

lines.zh: 我把自己团起来，先护住肚子。
lines.en: I ball myself up and shield my belly.

lines.zh: 你打偏了，打在我旁边的地上。
lines.en: You missed and struck the ground beside me.

lines.zh: 我一边跑一边回头看。
lines.en: I run and keep looking back over my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这点伤，舔一舔就好了。
lines.en: A little licking will fix this.

lines.zh: 我不记仇，但我会记住这个疼。
lines.en: I hold no grudge, but I will remember the pain.

lines.zh: 你手里那片叶子，我闻到了。
lines.en: I can smell the leaf in your hand.

lines.zh: 是甜甜的浆果吗，我全都要。
lines.en: Are those sweet berries? I want all of them.

lines.zh: 我踮起脚，够不到你的手。
lines.en: I stand on tiptoe and still cannot reach your hand.

lines.zh: 你蹲低一点，我就敢过来了。
lines.en: Crouch a little lower and I will dare come over.

lines.zh: 我吃得很快，也会记得留一点。
lines.en: I eat fast, though I remember to leave a little.

lines.zh: 这个比石像缝里的苔藓好吃多了。
lines.en: This tastes far better than the moss in the statue.

lines.zh: 我一边吃一边看你，怕你走。
lines.en: I eat and watch you at once, afraid you will leave.

lines.zh: 别摇手，食物会掉。
lines.en: Do not wave your hand; the food will fall.

lines.zh: 我闻到胡萝卜的甜味了，很淡。
lines.en: I smell carrot sweetness, faint but clear.

lines.zh: 你给的，我就敢吃。
lines.en: If it comes from you, I dare eat it.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞满了，还想再要。
lines.en: My cheeks bulge and I still nose for another bite.

lines.zh: 你能不能把食物放在石头上。
lines.en: Could you set the food down on the stone?

lines.zh: 吃完了，我用爪子擦擦嘴。
lines.en: When done, I wipe my mouth with a paw.

lines.zh: 这一口我要留到晚上。
lines.en: I will save this bite for the night.

lines.zh: 你手上那点红，是浆果吧。
lines.en: That red on your hand. Berries, right?

lines.zh: 我不抢，我就在你脚边等着。
lines.en: I will not snatch it. I will wait by your feet.

lines.zh: 你踩到我，我尖叫着弹开。
lines.en: You step on me and I squeak and bounce away.

lines.zh: 我撞在你靴子上，像撞一堵墙。
lines.en: I bump your boot like hitting a wall.

lines.zh: 我太轻了，你大概没感觉到。
lines.en: I am so light you probably felt nothing.

lines.zh: 撞完我躲到石头后面，先看看情况。
lines.en: After the bump I hide behind a stone to assess.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴被踩了一下，很疼。
lines.en: My tail got stepped on, and it stings.

lines.zh: 你退后一点，我的骨头太细。
lines.en: Step back a bit; my bones are very thin.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我翻了个跟头。
lines.en: We collide and I tumble head over heels.

lines.zh: 我蹭了蹭你的脚踝，是故意的。
lines.en: I rub against your ankle, and it was on purpose.

lines.zh: 别把我当球踢，我不是球。
lines.en: Do not kick me like a ball; I am not one.

lines.zh: 这一下把我吓得毛都炸开了。
lines.en: That knocked all my fur upright.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子碰碰她的鼻子，就这样。
lines.en: I touch her nose with mine, and that is all.

lines.zh: 我们共用一块暖石头，谁也不挤。
lines.en: We share one warm stone and neither shoves.

lines.zh: 她比我大一点，走在前面。
lines.en: She is a little bigger and walks ahead.

lines.zh: 我们互相理毛，理到睡着。
lines.en: We groom each other until we fall asleep.

lines.zh: 小的时候，一窝里有三只。
lines.en: As kits there were three of us in the litter.

lines.zh: 我给她留了最软的那片叶子。
lines.en: I saved the softest leaf for her.

lines.zh: 我们的叫声能对上，很有意思。
lines.en: Our calls match up, which is interesting.

lines.zh: 挤在一起睡，冬天就不冷了。
lines.en: Sleeping pressed together keeps winter away.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈走，她就跟着绕。
lines.en: I walk in a circle and she circles after me.

lines.zh: 石像里太挤了，我们挪到外面。
lines.en: The statue is too cramped; we move outside.

lines.zh: 我叼得动一粒种子，再大就不行。
lines.en: I can carry a seed; anything bigger is too much.

lines.zh: 我把亮亮的东西藏进石缝。
lines.en: I hide shiny things in the stone crack.

lines.zh: 你用两根手指就能拿走我捡的。
lines.en: Two of your fingers can take what I gathered.

lines.zh: 我捡起你掉的线头，绕在爪上。
lines.en: I pick up your dropped thread and wind it on my paw.

lines.zh: 这块小石子很像我的牙，我留着。
lines.en: This pebble looks like my tooth; I keep it.

lines.zh: 我咬着东西走路，头会歪。
lines.en: Carrying something makes my head tilt.

lines.zh: 别抢，我还没藏好。
lines.en: Do not snatch it; I have not hidden it yet.

lines.zh: 我只会捡小的，大的拖不动。
lines.en: I only pick up small things; big ones will not drag.

lines.zh: 你的纽扣掉了，我捡到了。
lines.en: You lost a button, and I found it.

lines.zh: 我把食物埋在土里，等会儿再来。
lines.en: I bury food in the soil and will return later.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近石像，我先竖起耳朵。
lines.en: Something nears the statue and my ears go up first.

lines.zh: 那影子太大，我决定躲。
lines.en: That shadow is too big; I decide to hide.

lines.zh: 你踩断的树枝，让我紧张起来。
lines.en: The twig you snapped puts me on edge.

lines.zh: 我弓起背，把毛全竖起来吓你。
lines.en: I arch my back and puff every hair to scare you.

lines.zh: 我的叫声很尖，能把同伴叫来。
lines.en: My call is shrill enough to summon the others.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢那个方向的味道。
lines.en: I do not like the smell from that direction.

lines.zh: 有爪子在刨土，我听见了。
lines.en: Something is digging, and I hear the claws.

lines.zh: 我先退到螺旋口，那里只有一条路。
lines.en: I back to the spiral mouth, where there is one way in.

lines.zh: 我盯着那处草动，不敢眨眼。
lines.en: I stare at the moving grass and dare not blink.

lines.zh: 我小小的，但我会咬。
lines.en: I am small, but I do bite.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，始终隔着那块石头。
lines.en: I circle you, always keeping that stone between us.

lines.zh: 你动一下，我就退一步。
lines.en: You move once, and I retreat one step.

lines.zh: 我在等你先失去耐心走开。
lines.en: I wait for your patience to run out first.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵一直朝着你的方向。
lines.en: My ears stay pointed toward you.

lines.zh: 我看你，也看你身后有没有别的。
lines.en: I watch you, and whatever might be behind you.

lines.zh: 你蹲着不动，我就敢多看一会儿。
lines.en: If you stay crouched and still, I dare look longer.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I hug the ground and make no sound.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我就缩回石缝里。
lines.en: You raise a hand and I slip into the crack.

lines.zh: 这条路我熟，你不熟。
lines.en: I know this path; you do not.

lines.zh: 你蹲着，我趴着，谁都不先动。
lines.en: You crouch, I flatten, and neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的手指，然后立刻松开。
lines.en: I nip your finger, then release before you can grab.

lines.zh: 我的门牙细得像针，咬人很疼。
lines.en: My front teeth are needle-thin and bite sharply.

lines.zh: 我用前爪抓，只抓出一道白痕。
lines.en: I claw with my forepaws and leave a white scratch.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，结果挂在你裤脚上。
lines.en: I leap and end up hanging from your trouser cuff.

lines.zh: 别逼我，我打架很难看。
lines.en: Do not corner me; I fight very badly.

lines.zh: 这一口是警告，不是要杀你。
lines.en: This bite is a warning, not a killing blow.

lines.zh: 我打完就跑，跑得比你快。
lines.en: I strike and run, and I run faster than you.

lines.zh: 我咬你的鞋带，因为够得着。
lines.en: I bite your shoelace because it is within reach.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在你手背上留下三道印。
lines.en: My claws leave three lines on the back of your hand.

lines.zh: 我抖着腿，其实怕得要命。
lines.en: My legs shake; I am actually terrified.

lines.zh: 石像裂开一道缝，我从里面爬出来。
lines.en: The statue cracks and I crawl out through it.

lines.zh: 我在这尊航蠕螺雕像里睡了很久。
lines.en: I slept a long time inside this nauticrawl statue.

lines.zh: 土被挖开，光刺得我睁不开眼。
lines.en: The soil is dug away and the light blinds me.

lines.zh: 我先探出鼻子，再探出整张脸。
lines.en: First my nose, then my whole face emerges.

lines.zh: 有人搬动了石头，我就醒了。
lines.en: Someone moved the stone, and I woke.

lines.zh: 我身上还带着石粉，抖了很久。
lines.en: I am still covered in stone dust and shake for a while.

lines.zh: 这里比雕像里亮，也比那里大。
lines.en: This place is brighter and larger than the statue.

lines.zh: 我闻到了草，还有别的活物。
lines.en: I smell grass, and something else alive.

lines.zh: 我出生在螺旋尽头，没走过远路。
lines.en: I was born at the spiral's end and never traveled far.

lines.zh: 我从壳里出来，第一次看见天空。
lines.en: I come out of the shell and see the sky.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我背上的毛就焦了。
lines.en: Fire comes near and the fur on my back singes.

lines.zh: 我从石头上滑下去，摔了个四脚朝天。
lines.en: I slip off the stone and land on my back.

lines.zh: 水没过头顶，我拼命划着爬上岸。
lines.en: Water closes over me; I paddle desperately to shore.

lines.zh: 炸响之后，我埋进土里只露尾巴。
lines.en: After the blast I am buried with only my tail out.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的耳朵，我愣住了。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my ear and I freeze.

lines.zh: 紫色的雾一罩，我的腿就不听使唤。
lines.en: Purple mist covers me and my legs stop obeying.

lines.zh: 我饿得啃石缝里的干苔，很难吃。
lines.en: Starving, I gnaw dry moss in the crack; it tastes awful.

lines.zh: 雷声太大，我钻进石缝不敢出来。
lines.en: The thunder is too loud; I hide in the crack.

lines.zh: 底下什么都没有，我抓紧了石头。
lines.en: There is nothing below, and I grip the stone.
